page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.8xlarge is a compute-focused instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 16 physical cores configured into 32 dedicated vCPUs via hyperthreading. Cache architecture includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. No local disk storage or dedicated GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance type, relying instead on network storage, and baseline network throughput is rated at 10 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addressing.

Performance benchmark testing reveals moderate multi-core compute capability paired with lower single-threaded throughput. The instance achieves a stress-ng multi-core score of 23616.79, a Geekbench multi-core rating of 8847.0, and a overall PassMark CPU score of 23037.68, placing it in the middle tier of multi-threaded execution capabilities. Single-core measurements rank in the bottom 25 percent, with stress-ng single-core performance scoring 1106.89 and single-threaded gzip compression achieving 19.05 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth testing demonstrates 95.0 GB/sec uncached read throughput and 45.75 GB/sec uncached write throughput.

The 1:1 ratio of memory capacity to virtual CPU count favors parallelized compute tasks that are not memory intensive. The instance provides cost efficiency for multi-threaded batch operations, code compilation, and static web serving, where raw vCPU core scaling provides value without paying for unneeded memory capacity. Workloads requiring high single-thread speeds or large in-memory footprints may experience performance bottlenecks on this configuration.
